name: Akme Fintrade (India) Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1996, Akme Fintrade (India) Ltd provides specialized retail financing services to the lower-income and middle-income groups[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
AFIL, an RBI-registered NBFC, focuses on rural and semi-urban finance, operating 28 branches and 30+ sales points across Rajasthan, Maharashtra, MP, and Gujarat. It serves 2+ lakh customers with an AUM of ₹523+ crore, borrowings of ₹240+ crore, GNPA of 2.86%, and NNPA of 1.27%.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.78 times its book value
Company is expected to give good quarter
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 0.44% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 9.57% over last 3 years.
Working capital days have increased from 45.8 days to 73.7 days
